title: thelypteris abrupta
intro: Thelypteris abrupta, commonly known as the abrupt lady fern, is a species of fern in the family Thelypteridaceae. It is a vascular plant that belongs to the division Pteridophyta. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine, and its health benefits include reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Thelypteris abrupta include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which may contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects.
